title: Automated Evidence Lifecycle Orchestrator for Jurisdictional Retention and Minimal-Access Snapshots
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Build an orchestrator that automates the full lifecycle of compliance artifacts (collection, immutable snapshotting, jurisdiction-aware retention enforcement, redaction, and auditable export) and exposes a queriable index for auditors and internal compliance. Focus on minimizing friction for customers with multi-region controls while preserving minimum-privilege access to stored evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Per-jurisdiction retention rules can be defined and attached to data categories and routes in the Console
Scheduled minimal-access snapshots are produced with an immutable manifest (SHA256) and stored in region-bound buckets compliant with the retention rule
Collectors support pluggable connectors (S3, DB dumps, runtime traces) and can be scoped to routes, tokens, or customer IDs
Export bundle generator produces an auditor-ready package containing a manifest, chain-of-custody log, and optional redaction layer
Audit queries return results within SLO (95% < 2s) for manifest lookup and evidence attribution
RBAC controls ensure only authorized compliance/service accounts can request full exports; UI shows read-only preview without sensitive fields
notes: Decision: use immutable manifests + content-addressed storage to avoid inadvertent tampering and make retention enforcement simpler
Trade-off: storing full snapshots increases storage; mitigate via configurable deltas and compression policies
Technical approach: orchestrator will schedule collectors, generate manifests, push to region-aware storage, then register metadata in the evidence index service

Privacy consideration: sensitive fields should be redacted at collection time using per-customer redaction templates; we will allow customers to opt into full unredacted packages under strict controls
Integration: tie into KMS for envelope encryption, and to existing audit-trace pipeline for chain-of-custody events
rollout_plan: Phase 1: internal POC with engineering compliance team in us-west-2; Phase 2: limited beta with 5 customers (mix of hosted and dedicated); Phase 3: general availability with documentation and UI controls. Monitor storage cost and export latency; enable feature flag for retention enforcement per-account.
test_plan: Unit tests for manifest generation and signature verification
End-to-end test: schedule a snapshot, verify storage location, manifest integrity, and retention TTL enforcement
Security review: penetration test on export flow and RBAC escalation scenarios
Audit scenario: simulate auditor package request and validate redaction, chain-of-custody, and delivery mechanisms
